text:
devon: FYI onboarding Cordelia LoRA merge into the 7B pipeline produced weird embedding shifts and a safety classifier regression on the quickpack. Starting this thread to triage.

alex: hmm, what shift are we seeing? numbers?

sara: want the eval command + outputs.

devon: embedding cosine drop ~0.12 on the canonical eval set (was ~0.02 pre-merge). Safety FPR up from 0.6% -> 3.2% on their internal classifier.

matt: any tokenizer changes? LoRA shouldn't touch tokenizer normally but sometimes clients add special tokens.

devon: they added two tokens `<CUST>` and `<ENTITY>` in their finetune pipeline — mapping looked ok but suspect KV-cache misalignment after int4 quant.

lia: also noticed drift in embed norm distribution: histogram_mean shifted down ~0.4, and std tightened.

alex: can we run a 50-sample A/B of pre-merge vs merged with `--no-kv-cache` to isolate caching effects?

devon: running now. command I'm using:
```bash
# quickpack A/B run
python quickpack/run.py --left base/cordelia-pt --right merged/cordelia-lora-int4 --batch 50 --seed 42 --no-kv-cache
```

eval-bot: Quickpack finished: left avg_cosine=0.987, right avg_cosine=0.872, delta=-0.115; safety_fpr left=0.006, right=0.032; sample_report: /tmp/quickpack-1745059999/report.html

sara: that's pretty decisive. Next steps: rollback merge, try remapping special tokens into a shared embedding space then re-run quantization with per-channel scales. Also try `--force-bfloat16-kv` quant-run to check if int4 is the root cause.

matt: I'm going to push a tokenizer mapping patch (PR #824) that remaps `<CUST>` -> `<cust_tag>` and aligns embeddings by index then rebake the tokenizer. Will run a small sanity A/B after.

devon: dropping the small sample artifacts here for review: https://redwood-internal/storage/cordelia/quickpack/1745059999/results.json (contains per-sample cosines and safety labels).

lia: after matt's patch, can we re-quantize with the bitsandbytes stable int4 backend and also run a canary on dedicated to catch perf regressions?

alex: tagging @eng-ml-oncall in case this affects any scheduled rollouts :wave:

eng-ml-oncall: acknowledged — will hold scheduled canary deployment for 30m and monitor GPU queues. ping if you need extra capacity.

devon: thanks all — I'll update once PR #824 lands and we have a new quickpack run. If we still see delta >0.05 we'll escalate to model-oncall and schedule a full eval sweep.
